messages:
Olivia R: quick thread: propose a small refactor — move "probe sanitization" and "route-hint derivation" out of hot path runtime into a light precompute step that can be shared by the console, sim, and runtime. Reason: duplication and different heuristics creeping up in each place.

Diego M: open question: does this become a sync call per request or an async cache that runtime consults? sync adds latency, async adds staleness.

Harpreet K: my vote is cache-backed async with short TTLs and synchronous fallback. pattern: runtime asks cache; if miss -> local compute inline; background job refreshes cache. That keeps 0 additional network hop on critical path for misses.

Olivia R: agreed re fallback. also want versioning on derived hints so runtime can tolerate format changes. simple schema: hint_version, route_id, penalty_score, expiry_ts. keep it compact.

Diego M: ops concerns: cache warmup and multi-region coherence. if precompute happens only in us-west then eu traffic will get stale hints. we should either precompute per-region or include region stamp per-hint.

Harpreet K: per-region stamp + origin-region field sounds fine. runtime preference: prefer same-region hints, fall back to cross-region hints if age < X. add a small age-adapter to inflate penalties for cross-region hints.

infra-bot: note: recommended k8s probe-precompute deploy size: 2 CPU, 1Gi memory baseline, HPA with cpu target 60%.

Olivia R: security note: hints can be signed + include tenant_id to prevent cross-tenant poisoning. also only accept aggregated probes (no raw user ids).

Diego M: API sketch (text only): POST /internal/hints with body: tenant, region, aggregates -> returns list of hints. runtime contract: if response absent or error -> runtime recomputes locally.

Harpreet K: perf estimation: precompute latency ~1-3ms when served from cache, full recompute inline ~8-15ms for worst-case long tail. net improvement for high QPS tenants if hit rate > ~20%. we need bench runs.

Olivia R: telemetry: hint_cache_hit_rate, hint_age_ms, precompute_p95, fallback_local_compute_count. also add an explainer endpoint that the console can call to map hint->rule decisions for debug.

Diego M: rollout plan: shadow mode first (write-only to cache), then read-shadows (runtime reads but still computes and compares), then opt-in per-tenant read, then global. each stage 48-72h.

Harpreet K: chaos tests: simulate cache partitions and delayed writes; ensure runtime fallback preserves correctness and that we don't regress tail latency.

Olivia R: open action items: (1) Olivia -> draft RFC + minimal API + versioning strategy, (2) Diego -> bench current inline calc on p99 probe shapes, (3) Harpreet -> implement cache-backed precompute PoC and k8s manifest, (4) infra-bot -> provide baseline resource numbers and runbook template. check-in Friday.

policy-bot: linked_rfc=1733339999-hint-precompute-rfc-draft.json, required_fields=[api_schema, region_strategy, rollback_plan, telemetry]

Diego M: small nit: define precompute TTL policy in RFC (suggested defaults: same-region 20s, cross-region 5s).

Harpreet K: +1. also let's add metric: percent_decisions_changed_when_using_hints so we can quantify behavioral drift.

Olivia R: great point. I'll include that. merging RFC after comments. :shipit:

Diego M: :thumbsup:

Harpreet K: :+1:
